changes.title: Randomised treatment-assignment source correction for efficacy missing-data sensitivity analyses
changes.description: Correct T20/T21/T22 missing-data sensitivity grouping from actual treatment to planned randomised treatment while preserving actual treatment as context and adding subject-level population provenance.
changes.rationale: The public pilot data contain 12 randomised subjects with TRT01P != TRT01A, all planned High Dose to actual Low Dose. None enters the current observed primary MMRM, but all are in the 254-subject missing-data target. Grouping rbmi by TRT01A therefore changed the imputation target from the planned 86/84/84 allocation to 86/96/72. The repair aligns sensitivity analyses with the randomised efficacy treatment assignment, preserves actual-treatment provenance, audits the 306-to-254-to-189-to-116 denominator chain and blocks silent future mismatch entry into the observed primary MMRM.
